about_the_game:
The Magic Realm demo has opened the first two chapters of the main storyline and the first level of the trial for everyone to experience

synopsis

The story of "Magical Realm" begins in a small town located in a dangerous misty forest, where a series of mysterious events occur. These events gradually push the protagonist to approach the hidden truth of the town by chance

Character portrait

Gameplay Introduction

We have added a variety of core play methods in the game, such as bounce mechanism, skill matching, role development system and potion system. Each system is linked to form a unique combat system with hundreds of combinations of freedom that can be combined by the players themselves, so that each player can have their own unique solution in the same boss battle.

content_descriptors.notes: The plot and recollections contain some descriptions of extreme violence; The scenes of damaged clothes during battles, the cover-up nudity when hit by monster skills, as well as some cover-up nudity in the plot and recollections；BDSM.
